scope: 2025 ICPC Wuhan A B C E F G H K M
limitations: Independent small-case checks; no online submissions or maximum-scale timing. H uses a simulated fixed-set oracle; adaptive safety and query bound are proved in the text. E negative cases rely on invariants; C impossible narrow boards rely on proof.

A.method: 2500 modular comparisons plus 500 signed floor-sum cases against direct day enumeration

B.method: 600 random rooted-tree fault systems; compressed implication graph versus all station subsets and returned assignment verification

C.method: all dimensions through 60; actual equal counts, no three equal, and eight-neighbor connectivity; no-solution family relies on proof

E.method: small multisets via explicit bounded-state move graph with expanded [-2,4] search, compared on [0,2] targets

F.method: all nonempty interval families for array sizes through four; every recursive pivot choice versus stabbing/height formula

G.method: 500 box-ball projections versus exhaustive active-face stationary candidates and feasibility

H.method: all subsets of a 12-value universe plus 1000 random 30-bit sets; exact oracle transcript and query bound

K.method: all row pairs through n=3; multi-source Dijkstra over every cross-row swap for true minimum cost

M.method: all principal minors of 100 random matrices, modular Gaussian elimination versus required determinant formula
